method: Per claim family (sport x hypothesis) from the 4 validation ledgers: verdict history ordered by run_ts, current status = last entry. Families with >1 distinct status flagged flipped.
story: The product is the self-grading. Nulls, not-testables and retractions are kept in the ledger and counted; a system that only ever confirmed would not be credible.
